findings.location: Translation — paragraph about support work for missionaries (paragraph beginning "Maisha hapa mjini ni rahisi...")
findings.source_quote: we were doing a lot of support work for our fellow missionaries there and making trips back to where we still felt was our home.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the mistranslated word 'wazundumisionari' to the standard Kiswahili term 'wazee wa misheni' or better 'wazionesheni' (or simply 'wafanyakazi wa misheni' / 'wazee wa misheni' depending on style). Preserve surrounding HTML and sentence structure.
findings.translation_quote: tulikuwa tukifanya kazi nyingi za kuunga mkono kwa wazundumisionari wenzetu walioko huko

findings.location: Translation — phrase rendering 'homemaker' (paragraph beginning "Kuwa mama na mchololezi wa nyumba...")
findings.source_quote: Being a mother and homemaker, no matter where in the world God has placed us, is a beautiful thing in itself...
findings.suggested_fix: Consider using a more natural Kiswahili term for 'homemaker', e.g. 'mashauri wa nyumbani', 'mkuu wa nyumba', or simply 'msimamizi wa nyumba' or 'mshauri wa moja kwa moja wa nyumba'. This is a stylistic suggestion; if you prefer a single word, 'msimamizi wa nyumba' reads naturally. Preserve HTML tags and sentence order.
findings.translation_quote: Kuwa mama na mchololezi wa nyumba, bila kujali wapi duniani Mungu ametuutaza, ni jambo zuri lenyewe ikiwa tunaona kweli jinsi lilivyo.
